sectors.trend: Banks led ASX gains but face mounting credit risk from housing downturn; CBA reports 15% drop in home loan applications; legal loopholes on loyalty pricing under scrutiny
sectors.implications: Near-term earnings support from NIMs, but provisioning risk rises if house prices fall 10%. CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX under pressure on credit cycles

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout concealed by war-driven demand; Macarthur clears WA bulk test; gold miners (Aurum, Dalaroo) expanding; Netherlands gold repatriation signals safe-haven demand
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face structural iron ore oversupply risk; gold names (GOLD.AX, DGL.AX) benefit from geopolitical uncertainty and central bank demand

sectors.trend: Oil supported by US-Iran tensions; nat-gas rising on weather/storage; TMK gas rates surge; Chevron $7B Venezuela bet; energy transition costs mounting; Beetaloo gas cartel scrutiny
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from gas price strength; energy transition cost overhang pressures utilities; TMK.AX positive on Mongolian drilling

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse exposes Ponzi-like dynamics in construction; housing construction to follow prices lower; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall; Victoria debt warnings
sectors.implications: CGC.AX, WBC.AX (construction exposure) at risk; REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face falling property valuations; rate-sensitive REITs under pressure

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging; EV adoption accelerates as fuel costs soar; VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX relatively defensive; EV transition benefits battery/charging names; consumer staples resilient

sectors.trend: Nvidia AI boom continues; ASIC audit probe at Big Four; data centre backlash; MSTR strategy failing; leveraged loan defaults easing to 0.87%
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited; ASIC scrutiny may pressure audit fees and corporate governance standards; credit conditions improving modestly

Iron ore structural shakeout masked by geopolitical demand

Energy transition cost overhang and gas price strength

EV adoption inflection point in Australia

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggering housing credit crunch
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs and construction; favour fixed-rate exposures
Avoid high-leverage construction names; monitor CGC.AX, WBC.AX project pipelines

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shakeout as war premium fades
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore; favour gold and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC audit probe spilling into broader corporate governance crisis
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review holdings with Big Four audit dependencies; favour companies with independent audit tracks
Monitor Victorian infrastructure and REIT exposures; watch ratings agency actions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overhang pressuring utilities
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prefer gas-exposed names (WDS.AX, SXG.AX) over renewables in near term

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on geopolitical safe-haven demand and central bank repatriation
opportunities.rationale: Netherlands gold pull, US-Iran tensions, and Dalaroo/Aurum production growth support gold prices

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on gas-exposed energy names ahead of TMK drilling and nat-gas price strength
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rate surge, US nat-gas storage concerns, and Beetaloo cartel dynamics support gas pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure on NIM expansion, hedged against credit provisioning
opportunities.rationale: Banks lead ASX but 15% loan application drop and 10% house price fall forecast create provisioning risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to construction and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse, 10% house price fall forecast, and looming 4th RBA hike create downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim pure iron ore concentration; diversify into gold and copper
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore shakeout hidden by war premium; structural oversupply risk once geopolitical premium fades

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive allocation ahead of potential 4th RBA hike
defensive_moves.rationale: GDP stalling, housing credit tightening, and construction fragility argue for caution on rate path

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with banks providing support but housing and construction headwinds capping upside. Fourth RBA hike risk creates volatility. Oil/gas strength offsets equity softness. Expect 2-3% two-way moves around ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural concerns around housing correction, construction fragility, and stalling GDP cap medium-term upside. Gold, gas, and defensive healthcare offer relative outperformance. Iron ore oversupply risk is the key swing factor for BHP/RIO/FMG. Energy transition cost overhang pressures utilities.
